auto_connect_enabled.label: Auto-connect on untrusted networks
auto_connect_enabled.description: When enabled, connects your default VPN whenever you join a Wi-Fi, Ethernet or cellular network that isn't in your trusted list.

auto_disconnect_on_trusted.label: Auto-disconnect on trusted networks
auto_disconnect_on_trusted.description: When enabled, disconnects a VPN this plugin auto-started once you're back on a trusted network. Never touches a VPN you started manually.

trust_all_ethernet.label: Treat any wired connection as trusted
trust_all_ethernet.description: Wired Ethernet is treated as trusted even if its connection name isn't in your trusted list. Turn this off if you plug into untrusted wired networks.

notify_on_autoswitch.label: Notify on automatic connect/disconnect
notify_on_autoswitch.description: Show a notification whenever the VPN is automatically connected or disconnected.

poll_interval_seconds.label: Check interval (seconds)
poll_interval_seconds.description: How often to check VPN and network status.

stable_checks.label: Stable checks before switching
stable_checks.description: How many consecutive checks a network change must persist before auto-connect/disconnect reacts. Higher values avoid flapping during Wi-Fi roaming.

panel.browse: Choose a file and import it
panel.forti_title: Fortinet SSL VPN with SAML sign-in
panel.forti_note: Runs openfortivpn directly (NetworkManager's Fortinet plugins can't do SAML). Connecting asks for your password via polkit, then opens the sign-in page in your browser - finish it within about 50 seconds. An openfortivpn config file can also be imported above.
panel.forti_missing: Needs openfortivpn 1.21+ and pkexec (polkit). On Arch: sudo pacman -S openfortivpn
